changelog:
**Summary: User identity handling is now fully automatic; skill usability and documentation greatly improved.**

- Reworked user identity flow: identity is now handled automatically and transparently by the system; users are never prompted for, nor shown, usernames or internal identifiers.
- Streamlined skill usage: users only need to provide video input or request reports; no more manual identity provision.
- Documentation updated for clarity—new module overview, visual table layouts, and bilingual support.
- History report queries now always use an API call with results formatted as Markdown tables; local report aggregation is no longer allowed.
- Obsolete or redundant files (like skill-card.md, outdated scripts/api_service.py) have been removed.
- Skill version bumped to 1.0.3 and open-source MIT-0 license added.
